Thanks Olivia — totally reasonable to reschedule. Nov 2 (09:30–12:00 PST) and Nov 5 (09:00–11:30 PST) both work for our team right now.

Quick answers to what you asked for: I attached a short POC checklist and a preliminary token estimate spreadsheet based on the usage profile you shared last week. High level notes on Dedicated vs Hosted for the trial:

- Hosted: fastest to start, no infra lift for you, shared capacity but we can gate with soft rate limits and quota increases for the trial; better if you want low setup friction.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, stronger throughput guarantees and network isolation, recommended if you want to run multi-user load tests or have stricter compliance requirements; requires a brief onboarding window (we typically schedule two half-days for provisioning and validation).

For capacity planning during the session we should:
1) lock expected concurrent users and peak tokens/sec (you gave ballpark numbers; the spreadsheet refines it),
2) set a target latency SLO for the demo (e.g., p95 < 200ms for single-turn prompts),
3) decide if you want KV cache enabled for prompt-heavy workflows (saves tokens and latency).

I'll schedule tentative calendar invites (marked as provisional) for Nov 2 and Nov 5 and include an agenda. Can you confirm which date your security and infra leads prefer?

Attachments: POC-checklist.pdf, FinVest-token-estimate.xlsx, Agenda-POC-kickoff.ics

Best,
Karthik Iyer
